title: Taking Apart and Putting Together: Tracking Objects Through Physical Transformations
abstract: arXiv:2611.27398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Transformation Tracking and Understanding (TTU), extending video object tracking to environments where objects undergo physical assemblies and disassemblies. TTU requires continuously tracking objects through transformations, identifying new entities, maintaining a state graph of their relationships, and assigning semantic labels to transformations. While foundation models (e.g., SAM 2/3) maintain tracklets through appearance changes, they cannot update semantic identities as objects physically evolve. Prior work addresses only disassemblies, relying on expensive searches triggered only when tracking fails. We propose Tracking Instances via Proposals and Overlaps (TIPO), a training-free framework that continuously infers transformations via a generate-evaluate-judge pipeline. translated_title: 拆解与组装：在物理变换中跟踪物体
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了变换跟踪与理解（TTU）任务，将视频目标跟踪扩展到物体经历物理组装与拆解的环境中。TTU 要求在变换过程中持续跟踪物体、识别新出现的实体、维护它们之间关系的状态图，并为变换赋予语义标签。虽然基础模型（如 SAM 2/3）能够在外观变化中维持轨迹片段，但当物体发生物理演变时，它们无法更新语义身份。先前的工作仅处理拆解场景，且依赖仅在跟踪失败时才触发的昂贵搜索。我们提出了基于提议与重叠的实例跟踪（TIPO），这是一个免训练框架，通过“生成-评估-判断”流水线持续推断变换。TIPO 从不相交的掩码组件中生成拆分与合并提议，利用内部与外部重叠度对照掩码解码器先验对其进行评分，并……
tldr: 提出免训练框架 TIPO，通过“生成-评估-判断”流水线使视频跟踪系统能在物体拆解与组装等物理变换中持续跟踪实例、推断变换并维护实体状态图。
en_tdlr: TIPO, a training-free framework, enables continuous object tracking and semantic understanding through physical assemblies and disassemblies via a generate-evaluate-judge proposal pipeline.
